_comment: Template for backend/app/scripts/seed_dev_data.py's Cognito-identity mapping. Copy this file to seed_dev_identities.json (same directory, gitignored) and replace every REPLACE_ME_* value with the email of a REAL Cognito user you've already created in the swarasa-dev user pool, in the matching pool group. Do not edit or commit this .example file with real emails.
_cognito_prerequisite: 6 Cognito users total, in the ONE swarasa-dev user pool, each in exactly one of its 4 groups: 2 in 'owner', 2 in 'manager', 1 in 'admin', 1 in 'registered_user'. Creating them is a separate AWS CLI step (cognito-idp admin-create-user + admin-add-user-to-group per user) that a human runs with explicit per-command approval -- this script and the agent that wrote it do not run it. 'admin' has no local DB record (docs/DATA_MODEL.md identity note) so it's listed here for documentation completeness only -- seed_dev_data.py never looks it up.

admin._note: Not used by the script (no table to write) -- keep filled in anyway so this file stays the single checklist of every Cognito user the dev environment needs.
